subject: Mathematics Methods
subtopics: Probability distributions, expectation and binomial models
html:
Spinners A and B have equally likely outcomes of 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 for A and 2, 3, 4, 5 for B. A player pays $2 for one play and wins $5 if the outcomes are the same, $2 if they differ by one, and nothing otherwise. Let XX be the player’s profit (winnings minus payment), in dollars, in one play.

  1. Explain why XX is a random variable and list its possible values. (2 marks)

  2. Determine E(X)E(X). (4 marks)

  3. Calculate Var(X)\operatorname{Var}(X). (2 marks)

  4. Determine the cost per play so that in the long run a player will break even. (1 mark)
